voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In October eighteen eighty-eight, in Leeds, a French inventor named Louis Le Prince filmed a few seconds of people walking in a garden.
It is among the oldest surviving motion pictures in the world.
Two years later, in September eighteen ninety, he boarded a train at Dijon, bound for Paris.
He never arrived. No body. No luggage. He was never seen again.
In two thousand three, a photograph of a man drowned in the Seine in eighteen ninety turned up in the Paris police archives. Whether it is him is disputed.
